name: Ninomiya Hajime
source:
He is the main character's best friend and is dating Mayu.

He is a sportsman with a solid physique, and he doesn't think too much and moves according to the mood of the moment, but he is not back-and-forth and treats everyone in the same way. Basically, he is a nice guy.

He loves to do erotic things and talk about erotic things. He is openly erotic. He is the type who focuses more on physicality than technique.

From [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/074/index.html]official site[/url]]
